text:
maya: Final draft of Product X launch post up on preview. Need quick pass: headline A/B, benchmark blurb, UTMs + webinar routing. Publish Thu 9am PT.

derek: Link?

maya: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/1819999999 — hero A: 'Predictable LLM inference at scale' / hero B: 'Sub-100ms median latency for production workloads' — running A/B. Thoughts?

zoe: Both work. Prefer A for first-time readers, B for email landing. If we're A/B testing, ensure meta description and OG tags map to variants.

priya: Ops needs UTMs for hero CTA, footer CTA, and the webinar form. Also confirm server-side tagging so direct clicks create HubSpot contacts with source=blog.

ops-bot: Proposed UTMs: hero CTA -> `?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=hero_cta&utm_campaign=productx_launch_ab` ; footer CTA -> `?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=footer_cta&utm_campaign=productx_launch_ab`. Webinar form hidden fields: `campaign=productx_launch_ab`, `lead_source=blog`, `interest=dedicated`. Recommend adding `marketing_experiment=heroA` or `heroB` to CTAs for variant attribution.

maya: Good call — add `marketing_experiment` param. Also include server-side rule: if no HubSpot cookie, set contact property `first_touch=blog_cta`.

derek: Benchmark blurb suggestion: "In Dedicated testing we observed sustained token throughput while median latency typically stayed near 100ms on representative prompts." Add reproducibility note: "(test config: 6xA100, seq_len=384, mixed-batch eval)" and collapse it on mobile.

zoe: Design will include a compact benchmark thumbnail and two hero PNGs for the A/B. Need final copy in ~90m to export assets.

legal: Quick flag: avoid absolutes like "guarantee" and direct competitor mentions. "Typically" and the test parenthetical are safer. Add privacy line by webinar form: "We process personal data per our Privacy Policy." I'll do a 15-min final pass after copy freeze.

publish-bot: preview deployed at https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/1819999999 — expires in 48h :rocket:

maya: Plan: freeze copy at 4:00pm PT, tag @legal for final pass at 4:05pm, ops to wire UTMs + server tags, design to deliver hero assets, schedule Thu 9am PT. Thanks all! :tada:
